headlines.title: Will Altria’s Pricing Power Triumph Over Tumbling Volumes on Oct 29?
headlines.summary: Altria reports October 29 with its stock up 35% this year, but the last two earnings days each sent shares tumbling. Whether Marlboro pricing can keep outrunning shrinking volumes while on! PLUS takes on ZYN will determine if that rally survives.

headlines.title: Altria Pays Out 89.3% of Its Earnings as Dividends. Here’s Why That Number Matters.
headlines.summary: Altria sends nearly all of its earnings straight to shareholders, leaving almost nothing in reserve, yet the board just approved another dividend raise. Understanding what keeps that math from falling apart reveals everything about whether the 5.68% yield holds or breaks.

description: Altria Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells smokeable and oral tobacco products in the United States. It offers cigarettes primarily under the Marlboro brand; large cigars and pipe tobacco under the Black & Mild brand; moist smokeless tobacco and oral tobacco products under the Copenhagen, Skoal, Red Seal, and Husky brands; oral nicotine pouches under the on! brand; and e-vapor products under the NJOY ACE brand. The company sells its products to distributors, as well as large retail organizations, such as chain stores. Altria Group, Inc. was founded in 1822 and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.
